classification.difficultyReason: Use the supplied trapezium decomposition to derive a general cyclic coordinate-area identity, then interpret signed orientation and zero-area degeneracy.

inlines.latex: \begin{gathered}\text{Area of triangle }ABC=\text{area of trapezium }ALNC\\+\text{area of trapezium }CNMB-\text{area of trapezium }LABM\end{gathered}

spec.description: Triangle above the positive x-axis, with A, C and B in that left-to-right order. Vertical dashed projections end at L, N and M. Ordinary outlines and vertices use house black; decorative blue fill is omitted. The origin numeral is omitted under the graph convention.
spec.mathematics: x_1<x_3<x_2; AL, CN and BM are vertical, with lengths y_1, y_3 and y_2. C is above AB. Coordinates used for drawing encode only the supplied qualitative relationships.
spec.answerVisibility: All diagram content is permanently visible; no answers are supplied.

children.label: a
children.prompt:
Use this observation to prove that:
$$\text{Area of triangle }ABC=\frac12\left(x_1(y_2-y_3)+x_2(y_3-y_1)+x_3(y_1-y_2)\right).$$

answer.worked:
The parallel sides of the three trapezia have lengths $y_1,y_3$; $y_3,y_2$; and $y_1,y_2$, respectively. Their perpendicular distances are $x_3-x_1$, $x_2-x_3$ and $x_2-x_1$.

$$\begin{align*}2A_{ABC}&=(y_1+y_3)(x_3-x_1)+(y_2+y_3)(x_2-x_3)-(y_1+y_2)(x_2-x_1)\\2A_{ABC}&=y_1x_3+y_3x_3-y_1x_1-y_3x_1+y_2x_2+y_3x_2-y_2x_3-y_3x_3-y_1x_2-y_2x_2+y_1x_1+y_2x_1\\2A_{ABC}&=x_1(y_2-y_3)+x_2(y_3-y_1)+x_3(y_1-y_2)\\A_{ABC}&=\frac12\left(x_1(y_2-y_3)+x_2(y_3-y_1)+x_3(y_1-y_2)\right).\end{align*}$$

children.label: b
children.prompt: Use the formula to calculate the area of the triangle $ABC$ where $A$, $B$ and $C$ have coordinates $(2,3)$, $(4,1)$ and $(3,6)$, respectively.

children.label: c
children.prompt: Find the area of the triangle $DEF$ where $D$, $E$ and $F$ have coordinates $(2,5)$, $(4,6)$ and $(3,2)$ respectively. Explain the answer.

answer.short: $\frac72$ square units. The formula gives $-\frac72$ because the vertex order has the opposite orientation; geometric area is positive.
answer.worked:
Let $S$ denote the signed expression supplied in part a.

$$\begin{align*}S&=\frac12\left(2(6-2)+4(2-5)+3(5-6)\right)\\S&=\frac12(8-12-3)\\S&=-\frac72.\end{align*}$$

$F$ lies below the line segment $DE$, reversing the orientation used in the supplied diagram. The negative sign records this orientation. The geometric area is $|S|=\frac72$ square units.

children.label: d
children.prompt: If the area determined by this formula is zero, what can be said about the points?

answer.worked: Zero area means the triangle is degenerate: its vertices lie on one straight line. Therefore the points are collinear.
